verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no bulk search, bulk registration, bulk renewal, bulk nameserver change, or bulk transfer feature. The Registrar API is only a developer building block that could be scripted into bulk workflows, so it earns no credit. Dashboard portfolio management describes per-domain flows, and community reports say custom nameservers aren't supported, which rules out bulk nameserver changes.

support.subject: As a power user managing a portfolio, bulk operations are real — bulk search, registration, renewal, nameserver changes, and transfers across many domains at once
